description: Source code for a search widget in a Qt-based text editing application, including classes for search UI and popup menu with search options.

classes.name: PopupMenu
classes.description: Custom context menu for search options, including modes for plain text, whole words, and regex, with case sensitivity toggle.

classes.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget
classes.description: Widget providing search and replace functionality within a QPlainTextEdit, with UI controls and search logic.

methods.name: PopupMenu::onActionPlainTextTriggered
methods.description: Handles trigger for plain text search mode.

methods.name: PopupMenu::onActionWholeWordsTriggered
methods.description: Handles trigger for whole words search mode.

methods.name: PopupMenu::onActionRegularExpressionTriggered
methods.description: Handles trigger for regex search mode.

methods.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget::activate
methods.description: Activates the search widget, optionally in replace mode.

methods.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget::activateReplace
methods.description: Activates the widget in replace mode.

methods.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget::setReplaceMode
methods.description: Enables or disables replace mode UI.

methods.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget::doSearch
methods.description: Performs search in the text edit, with options for direction and restart.

methods.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget::doReplace
methods.description: Replaces current selection or performs replace all.

methods.name: QPlainTextEditSearchWidget::doReplaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all matches in the document.
